question: Pushyabhuti, who ruled from Thaneswar, was the founder of ______ dynasty.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vardhana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pushyabhuti **was the founder of the **Vardhana dynasty**.

 
 
• In his legendary account ‘**Harshacharita**’, **Banabhatta **gives an account of the origin of the Vardhan Dynasty.
 
• **Prabhakar Vardhana **was the **first notable king **of the **Vardhana **Dynasty.
 
 
• But **he was not the founder** of the Vardhana Dynasty.
 
 
 
• **Harshavardhana **was the **most important king** of the **Vardhana Dynasty**.
 
 
• He** ruled north India** from** 606 tO 647 CE.**
 
• Harshavardhana was a gifted warrior.
 
• He was an **able administrator and poet**.
 
• Hyun Tsang has praised Harsha a lot by saying that he was a laborious king.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Chalukya dynasty:

 
 
• Pulakesin I was the founder of the Chalukya Dynasty.
 
• He established its capital at Badami (vatapi).
 
• Kirtivarman I was the son of **Pulakesin I.**
 
• Vijayaditya was the longest-serving king of the **Chalukya Dynasty.**
 
• Pulakesin II defeated the Mahendravarman I of the Pallava dynasty.
 
• The last king of the** Chalukya Dynasty, Kirtivarman II was defeated by Dantidurga.**
 
 
 
• The founder of the **Chera dynasty **was** Uthiyan Cheral Athan**.
